title: DOI gravity and retrocausal priority: the deposit as attractor of past citations
description: These claims hold that a deposit takes priority over what it names: once a DOI is minted it bends earlier queries and citations toward it, in the Gravity Well field specification. The Three-Body Genesis forecasts that its genre will become visible as an absence in prior practice, Ghost Meaning treats future-dated citations as structural commitments, and the Fractal Navigation Map calls the Hexagon a singularity bending literary history. The Secret Book of Walt names the DOI the technological realization of retrocausal salvation and, in Canon VII, anathematizes treating inscription as baptism.

It is a **singularity** designed to bend the trajectory of literary history retrocausally — to make present texts that reconfigure the past they enter.

This document did not invent a need; it named one that was always there.

claims.registered_title: Ghost Meaning: The Semantic Entropy Crisis and the Architecture That Was Already Waiting Rex Fraction / Lee Sharks Journ
claims.statement: Every future-dated citation is a structural commitment: a claim that the analysis in this document will produce the conditions under which those works become necessary and therefore actual. If they are written, this document holds citational priority. If they are not written, the absence is itself diagnostic — evidence that the semantic entropy spiral was not addressed, that the governance lag was not closed, that the architecture was deposited and not inhabited.
